capabilities: apply Google Docs style shortcuts for headings 1 through 6 and normal text
toggle blockquotes, bulleted lists, numbered lists and checklists by hotkey
replace built-in bold and italic commands with versions that work across list lines and insert the cursor inside markup
extras: Author warns the plugin comes with no guarantee of stability, that bugs may delete data, and recommends keeping automated backups. Some listed hotkeys (strikethrough, bold, italics) are marked as coming soon.
intentEvidence: Yes, these are included in Obsidian by default but these versions are improved in the following ways
problem: Obsidian does not provide Google Docs style keyboard shortcuts for formatting text, and its built-in bold and italic commands have limitations in lists and unselected text.

relations.evidence: Google Docs style keyboard shortcuts for Obsidian.

summary: Adds Google Docs style keyboard shortcuts for applying headings, lists, blockquotes, bold and italics in notes.
